Package com.unitech.lib.uhf.types

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    PowerDutyLimitationMap
    The PowerDutyLimitationMap enumeration represents the type of device associated with the SDK.
  • Enum Summary 
    Enum Description
    AlgorithmType
    The AlgorithmType enumeration represents the algorithm by which the RFID UHF module inventories the TAG.
    BankType
    The BankType enumeration specifies the memory bank of the RFID UHF tag.
    BLFType
    The BLFType enumeration represents the BLF by which the RFID UHF module inventories the TAG.
    Encoding
    The Encoding enumeration represents the miller encoding by which the RFID UHF module inventories the TAG.
    GlobalBandType
    The GlobalBandType enumeration represents the frequency direction of the RFID UHF module.
    LockState
    The LockState enumeration represents the lock state.
    Mask6cAction
    The Mask6cAction enumeration type indicates the status of the Flag when the RFID UHF module performs the Inventory operation and the pattern of the given Selection Mask is set as the Target value of the Selection Mask according to the condition.
    Mask6cTarget
    The Mask6cTarget enumeration represents the Flag where the result status of the Selection Mask will be saved when the RFID UHF module is inventoried.
    PowerMode
    The PowerMode enumeration specifies the power mode while inventory.
    Session
    The Session enumeration represents the session of the TAG to be the Inventory target when the RFID UHF module is running the Inventory.
    Target
    The Target enumeration type indicates the status of the Target of the TAG to be the Inventory target when the RFID UHF module is running the Inventory.
    TARIType
    The TARIType enumeration represents the TARI by which the RFID UHF module inventories the TAG.
